subject: Bluestone Health — model fit handoff & staging instructions
message_1_subject: Recap: today's discovery + next steps for clinical summarization eval
message_1_body:
Hi Emma,

Thanks for the time this morning — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single record: 

Summary of needs
- Use case: generate concise clinical discharge summaries from multi-note patient records for downstream clinician review.
- Success criteria you called out: high entity fidelity (critical meds/procedures), minimal hallucination, and median latency < 50ms for 1–2k token contexts.
- Compliance: dataset must be PII-scrubbed or ingested into a private staging VPC; you flagged SOC2+HIPAA requirements.

Proposed Redwood two-stage eval
1) Sanity run (small sample, 200 records) — quick model shortlist and basic signal for hallucination and entity F1.
2) Full benchmark (3k–5k records) — final pass/fail vs. your acceptance thresholds.

Initial asks for BlueStone
- Share a 200-record sample in CSV (columns: record_id, clinical_notes, reference_summary). If any PHI remains, please indicate and we'll use Private deployment options.
- Confirm whether we should route staging traffic via S3 presigned links or a Drive folder.

Redwood recommended starting models (based on similar clinical workloads):
- rw-open-13b-q4 (cost-efficient quantized variant for low latency)
- rw-llama3-13b-8bit (strong balance of quality/latency for abstractive tasks)
- redwood-alpaca-7b-fp16 (fast baseline to validate latency/throughput)

Scoring we propose for acceptance (we'll provide workbook):
- Clinical-entity F1 (NER-based, per-patient averaged) — target >= 0.88
- Hallucination rate (entity-level false positives) — target <= 3%
- ROUGE-L (for surface overlap) as a secondary signal
- Median per-request latency (99th-pct monitored) — target median < 40ms, p99 < 200ms for single-token streaming

I'll stand up the small sanity run once you drop the sample. We can handle the scoring and provide the scoring_template_v1.xlsx and prompt_set_v2.txt (see attachments).

Proposed next dates for a technical kickoff with our ML engineer (30–45m): Wed Mar 17 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu Mar 18 8:00–9:00 PT. Please confirm a slot and the preferred ingestion path.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachments: scoring_template_v1.xlsx (scoring rubric draft), prompt_set_v2.txt (starter prompt variants)

message_3_subject: Plan: benchmark scaffolding, scoring details & staging options
message_3_body:
Emma — thanks for the quick turnaround and for uploading the sample. A few additional details and answers to your questions: 

1) Hallucination metric
- We'll compute hallucination at the entity level: NER-extracted entities from model output that are not present in the ground-truth reference. That gives a clear operational signal you can act on. For the full benchmark we recommend a small manual adjudication set (~200 records) to calibrate NER thresholds.

2) Audit logs & retention
- Redwood Private and Dedicated support request-level audit logs (timestamp, model, route, truncated prompt hash, requester id) — we can provide a sample log schema during the kickoff. Retention is configurable; we typically propose 90 days for staging and 1 year for enterprise audits (we can align to your policy).

3) Models and evaluation steps (detailed)
- Candidate family A (cost-efficient): rw-open-13b-q4 — quantized variant for higher throughput.
- Candidate family B (quality/latency balance): rw-llama3-13b-8bit.
- Baseline (fast fail): redwood-alpaca-7b-fp16.

Sanity run (200 records) — timeline: 48–72h after we get the sample + read-only S3/Drive link - Outputs: per-model CSV with predictions, per-record entity extraction, basic hallucination counts, and spreadsheet summary.

Full benchmark (3k–5k) — timeline: 5–7 business days once data and credentials are in place - Outputs: scoring_template_v1.xlsx populated, ROC-style curves for threshold sensitivity, and a short technical report with recommended model/prompt for production.

4) Continuous regression detection
- Redwood Optimize can run scheduled evaluation jobs against a stored baseline and incoming traffic samples. Alerts can be configured when entity F1 drops >3% from baseline or hallucination increases >2pp. We will set up an initial alerting workflow in the kickoff.

5) Next technical steps we need from BlueStone
- Read-only S3 role ARN or Drive folder with edit link for the sample and full dataset.
- A point of contact from infra for the IAM role (name + email).
- Confirmation if you want the staging run in our Hosted environment or Private (VPC). Given the de-id sample, Hosted is fine for the sanity run; Private preferred for the full benchmark.

I've attached the scoring_template_v1.xlsx and prompt_set_v2.txt to this thread and pushed a copy to the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ExampleBenchmark.

I'll turn on a small sandbox job as soon as you share the S3/Drive details. See you on Wed at 10:00 PT — I'll add Karthik and Marissa to the invite.

Best,
Ben
